summary: Depth-first rabbithole dossier for DATE criteria date format specifications; source-anchored research pack.

facts.text: [low] Once an online archive is created, you cannot modify the date field. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/online-archive/configure-online-archive-standard.md
[low] You cannot use the _id field as the date field for an Online Archive. (verified as of 2026-10-15) Sources: https://mongodb.com/community/forums/t/online-archive-using-id/277894

[high] The valid date format values for the DATE criteria are ISODATE, EPOCH_SECONDS, EPOCH_MILLIS, EPOCH_NANOSECONDS, or OBJECT_ID, with ISODATE as the default. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/online-archive/configure-online-archive-standard.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/command/atlas-clusters-onlineArchives-create.md, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/docs/resources/online_archive.md, https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/onlinearchive/

[low] If the date format is set to EPOCH_SECONDS, EPOCH_MILLIS, or EPOCH_NANOSECONDS, the value of the specified date field must be of the BSON type long. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/online-archive/configure-online-archive-standard.md

[high] If the collection type is TIMESERIES, you must set the criteria type to DATE. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/docs/resources/online_archive.md, https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/onlinearchive/

[low] If DATE is selected as the criteria type, the partition_fields.field_name must be completed with the dateField value. Sources: https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/onlinearchive/

[low] Documents matching the criteria are those where the current date is greater than the value of the date field plus the number of days specified via the expire_after_days parameter. Sources: https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/issues/1081

[low] A sample criteria configuration uses type DATE, date_field timestamp, date_format ISODATE, and expire_after_days 7. Sources: https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/issues/1081

[low] The date field must be an already indexed date field from the documents and is mutually exclusive with the --file parameter. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/command/atlas-clusters-onlineArchives-create.md
[low] The criteria.dateField parameter defaults as the first item in the partition sequence. Sources: https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/onlinearchive/
